panels.title: RQ-1 Skills, agents and commands used

targets.rawSql:
-- RQ-1: Which skills, agents and slash commands did the team use, and which went unused?
-- A name whose last_used is weeks old is one the team stopped using.
SELECT kind, name, CAST(sum(times) AS BIGINT) AS times, count(DISTINCT "user") AS people, max(last_day) AS last_used
FROM usage_names
WHERE kind IN ('skill', 'agent', 'command')
GROUP BY kind, name
ORDER BY kind, times DESC, name;

panels.title: RQ-2 Cost of a pull request, by project and agent

targets.rawSql:
-- RQ-2: What does a pull request cost, by project and by agent? Cost is the loop's estimate at API prices.
SELECT coalesce(project, 'factory') AS project, agent, count(*) AS pull_requests,
       round(sum(cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd, round(sum(cost_usd) / count(*), 2) AS usd_per_pr,
       CAST(sum(tokens) // count(*) AS BIGINT) AS tokens_per_pr
FROM loop_runs
WHERE outcome = 'pr'
GROUP BY project, agent
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST, project, agent;

panels.title: RQ-3 Fix rounds by agent, reviewer and factory version

targets.rawSql:
-- RQ-3: How many fix rounds does an issue take, by agent, reviewer and factory version?
SELECT agent, reviewer, coalesce(factory_version, 'unknown') AS factory_version, count(*) AS runs,
       round(avg(rounds), 2) AS mean_rounds, max(rounds) AS most_rounds
FROM loop_runs
GROUP BY agent, reviewer, factory_version
ORDER BY factory_version DESC, agent, reviewer;

-- RQ-4: Where does the guard refuse or ask most, and which asks do people always say yes to?
-- An ask whose approved equals asked is one people always say yes to: a candidate to loosen.
SELECT name, CAST(sum(times) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'guard_deny') AS BIGINT) AS refused,
       CAST(sum(times) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'guard_ask') AS BIGINT) AS asked,
       CAST(sum(times) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'ask_approved') AS BIGINT) AS approved
FROM usage_names
WHERE kind IN ('guard_deny', 'guard_ask', 'ask_approved')
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY coalesce(refused, 0) + coalesce(asked, 0) DESC, name;

-- RQ-5: Is every node's loop running, and when did each last report?
SELECT node, max(ts) AS last_heartbeat, date_diff('minute', max(ts), now()) AS minutes_since,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE alive) AS loops_alive, count(*) AS loops, CAST(sum(waiting) AS BIGINT) AS waiting
FROM loop_beats
GROUP BY node
ORDER BY minutes_since DESC, node;

panels.title: RQ-7 All-in cost of an issue that reached a pull request, by project

targets.rawSql:
-- RQ-7: What does an issue that reached a pull request cost all in, counting every loop run on it, and how much
-- loop spend sits on issues that have no pull request yet, by project? A pull request here is one the loop
-- opened, not one that merged. Cost is the loop's estimate at API prices; a cost the runs never recorded stays
-- null rather than reading as 0.
SELECT coalesce(project, 'factory') AS project, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reached) AS issues_with_pr,
       round(sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE reached), 2) AS all_in_cost_usd,
       round(sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE reached) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE reached), 0), 2) AS usd_per_issue,
       round(sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE NOT reached), 2) AS no_pr_cost_usd,
       round(100 * sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE NOT reached) / nullif(sum(cost), 0), 1) AS no_pr_percent
FROM (
    SELECT project, issue, coalesce(bool_or(outcome = 'pr'), false) AS reached, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
    FROM loop_runs
    GROUP BY project, issue
)
GROUP BY coalesce(project, 'factory')
ORDER BY all_in_cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST, project;
